question: How are the two portfolio bots built and how are they evaluated?
answer_X:
The two portfolio bots are built using the same documents, answer model (Llama 3.1 8B on Cloudflare Workers AI), prompt, evidence budget, and citation checks. The only difference between them is the retrieval method used. 

The first bot, Version 1, is a full-context assistant that loads the whole portfolio profile into the system prompt and asks the GLM-4.7-Flash model to answer only from that profile, without a retrieval step. 

The second bot, Version 2, is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) bot that first retrieves relevant text from the knowledge base, then the answer model writes its reply from that text. 

The two bots are evaluated on a hand-labelled set of questions, each tagged with the section that should answer it. The evaluation metrics include retrieval scores (first-result recall, top-3 recall, and mean reciprocal rank) and answer scores (citation validity, correct refusals, and latency). answer_Y:

Bot A is a standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) bot that searches short passages of the knowledge base using BM25 keyword search and embedding search, merges the two rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and passes the top five passages to the answer model. 

Bot B is a structure-aware RAG bot inspired by the STAIR paper, which picks up to three sections from the knowledge base's table of contents, checks the choice against the list of real section IDs, and passes the text of those sections to the same answer model.
